_README: HAND-CURATED photo overrides — the last word in photo resolution. An entry here beats photoRepick.json and P18. `null` means: every available photo fails the quality bar (recent + sharp + face-on), so render the initials card instead — a deliberate design, never a bad photo. Keys are Wikidata Q-ids. box = face rectangle as fractions of the source image, from /tmp/facebox.
